# ClickHouse

ClickHouse is a fast open-source column-oriented database management system for real-time analytics and big data processing with SQL support

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/clickhouse/.

## Actions

- **Execute ClickHouse Query** (read-only): Execute a sql query in clickhouse and return the results.
- **Get Database Schema** (read-only): Get comprehensive schema overview of an entire database including all tables and optionally their column definitions.
- **Get Table Schema** (read-only): Get detailed schema information for a specific table including column definitions, types, keys, and optionally sample data.
- **List ClickHouse Databases** (read-only): List all databases in the clickhouse instance.
- **List ClickHouse Tables** (read-only): List tables in clickhouse databases.
